# Hypertension diagnosis, treatment, control over time among age 45-64
### 0.25 year increments
```{r}
# List of variables and their y-axis labels
variables <- list(
  p_htn_4564 = "Prevalence of hypertension among adults aged 45-64 years",
  p_diag_htn_4564 = "Proportion of adults aged 45-64 years with hypertension who are diagnosed",
  p_on_tx_htn_4564 = "Proportion of adults aged 45-64 years with hypertension who are treated",
  p_htn_ctrl_4564 = "Proportion of adults aged 45-64 years with hypertension with SBP <140"
)

# Loop over variables to create summary data and plots
plots <- list()

for (var in names(variables)) {
  # Summarize data
  summary_df <- df %>%
    group_by(cald, policy) %>%
    summarize(
      median = median(.data[[var]]),
      lower_90 = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.05),
      upper_90 = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.95),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Generate plot
  p <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = cald, color = policy, fill = policy)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = median), size = 1.2) +  # Median line
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_90, ymax = upper_90), alpha = 0.2) +  # Shaded 90% range
    labs(
      title = paste("Median and 90% Range of", var, "Over Time by Policy"),
      x = "Time (cald)",
      y = variables[[var]],  # Custom y-axis label
      color = "Policy",
      fill = "Policy"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()  # Clean theme
  
  # Add to list of plots
  plots[[var]] <- p
}

# Display plots
print(plots[["p_htn_4564"]])
print(plots[["p_diag_htn_4564"]])
print(plots[["p_on_tx_htn_4564"]])
print(plots[["p_htn_ctrl_4564"]])

```

```{r}
}

# Display plots

```
